builtBy: Research by hand, 2026-11-21: Hudl's public rosters for every school's boys basketball teams and a SportsRecruits profile-address probe, over the 279 JV players MaxPreps lists; each Hudl page read twice.
notes: The JV players' own recruiting pages, linked by the rule of data/basketball/rosters-enrichment.json's profiles[]. Joined on team slug + the name the team page's JV list gives. 60 pages for 60 players (60 Hudl). No claimed-MaxPreps pages (the JV career pages were not read). A player on both the JV list and the varsity roster has his pages in the varsity file. A JV page stating a class year one ahead of a stale MaxPreps grade is not linked (the JV check has no grade-conflict marker). Recall is partial.
